CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR  ORAL ORDER

After arguing the matter for some time, the learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petition may be disposed of as withdrawn reserving liberty in favour of the petitioner to seek discharge/file a discharge application along with the documents, which may be directed to be considered by the trial Court in accordance with law.

3. The petition stands disposed of reserving liberty in favour of the petitioner to seek discharge/file a discharge application along with documents, which shall be considered by the trial Court in accordance with law.

It is made clear that this permission granted by this Court in favour of the petitioner to NC: 2025:KHC:5974 produce documents along with the discharge application, is made in the peculiar/special facts and circumstances of the instant case and shall not be treated as a precedent nor shall carry any precedential value for any purpose whatsoever.

4. Subject to the aforesaid liberty granted in favour of the petitioner to seek discharge/file a discharge application along with documents, petition stands disposed of without expressing any opinion on the merits of the claim of the petitioner.
